description: Turn sales training, kickoffs, and dealer conferences into AI-customized B2B sales simulations, with team practice, instructor facilitation, and evidence-backed debriefs.

display.description_en: Turn sales training, kickoffs, and dealer conferences into AI-customized B2B sales simulations, with team practice, instructor facilitation, and evidence-backed debriefs.
display.description_zh: 为销售内训、销售年会和经销商大会定制 AI 大客户销售沙盘，支持分组演练、讲师带教与证据化复盘，帮助销售、售前和交付团队练习客户决策链分析与协同推进。
examples_en: Plan a half-day B2B sales simulation for a manufacturing sales team, focused on buying committees and teamwork
Design a team sales simulation for an 80-person sales kickoff instead of more presentations; start with the agenda, groups, and preparation
Plan an industry-specific sales simulation where manufacturers and dealers form mixed teams to practice winning accounts together
Design a customer-scenario simulation for sales, presales, and delivery teams to practice information sharing, resource tradeoffs, and coordinated next steps
Debrief this SalesNail simulation using each team's classroom action records: compare stakeholder coverage, resource allocation, and next-round improvements
examples_zh: 给制造业销售团队设计半天的大客户销售沙盘培训，重点练习客户决策链分析和团队协同，先给我方案
80 人销售年会不想只听报告，帮我设计一场分组销售沙盘，先列出流程、分组和准备事项
经销商大会上想让厂家和经销商混编组队，练习联合攻单，帮我设计贴近行业的销售沙盘
销售、售前和交付总是配合不到一起，帮我设计客户情境沙盘，练习信息共享、资源取舍和推进节奏
复盘这次 SalesNail 销售沙盘，结合各组课堂行动记录，分析客户覆盖、资源分配和下一轮改进建议
